verdict.rationale: HeyGen ships a first-party Video Agent that takes a delegated task: you describe the video or pick a style and the agent "handles the rest." You can review its storyboards, send follow-up messages, iterate before generating, and later revise only the scenes you name. The docs also describe an assistant that maps described work to the endpoints that automate it. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Video Agent, explicit documentation of the in-app (non-API) assistant experience, evidence of delegation beyond video-generation tasks.
